title: Shape-intensity knowledge distillation for robust medical image segmentation (SIKD)
mechanism: A teacher trained on class-wise averaged training images (each labelled region set to its mean intensity) learns texture-free shape-intensity cues and distils them into a same-size student.
adaptation: Class-average EL cells over all 24 classes (removes grain, finger texture and source gain); distil into the house student; effect expected on structural classes, inactive and E1 texture shift rather than 1-2 px cracks.
min_experiment: Arm: house student + SIKD teacher distillation, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metrics: mIoU_rob, E1 crack relF1@2. Kill: mIoU_rob < +0.01 and E1 relF1@2 < +0.02.
evidence: R (web summary): improves baselines on five medical segmentation tasks and generalises better to unseen datasets.
prior_overlap: none. Distillation listed as never tried.
